name: traces_server_latency_p95_anomaly
title: Server span p95 latency is unusually high
description: The p95 duration of SERVER spans across the traces stream is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Unit: microseconds. Whole stream; add a service_name filter after install for a per-service alert (one config per service). Needs applications sending OpenTelemetry traces to the traces stream named default.
